address: Via Cardinale Ascanio Sforza 77, Milan, 20141, Italy
bio: A new contemporary-style bistro which has moved to Milan from Bologna, which offers three tasting menus (simply named Terra, Mare and Vegetariano) from which courses can also be chosen à la carte style. The dishes are colourful, balanced and generous, with a focus on top-quality ingredients and combinations that follow the seasons. You don’t even have to worry about parking – the restaurant pays for two hours at a garage right opposite the building, on the other side of the Naviglio Pavese canal....
